title: Visual Vibration when Camera2D is moving with "stationary" background Sprite2Ds or Color/TextureRects
body:
### Tested versions

Version 4.4.1

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot 4.4.1 - Forward+ Renderer - NVidia RTX 5080 - AMD 9700X - 64 GB of System memory

### Issue description

just something I was noticing doing a simple project. The backgrounds I was using with ColorRects were noticeably vibrating when the camera was following the player. The same happens in scaled TextureRects (meaning I set a minimum X/Y size using the same image but oddly not when I used the same png image in a TextureRect without scaling down the texturerect minimum size values. 

Steps I tried to mitigate:

1)I made sure to try in Exclusive Fullscreen mode since in Windows there can be hitching if you aren't doing that even in simple 2D projects, but there was no change

2) My monitor is set to 60 Hz, my physics tick is 60/s (and I'm not even using physics process)

3) I tried both with camera smoothing turned on and off

4) There is no stretch or anything

5) I tried in both Godot mono and Godot both versions 4.4.1 and saw this issue 6) Tried with a sprite 2D as a background and unscaled it seemed to also not display any jitter

Not sure if there's a fix or something silly I'm over looking? I don't think this is the usual jitter issues though as there isn't an issue with physics interpolation in this example. Unless of course the scaled texturerects or scaled rects are doing this? I do know that .SVG files used as the moving sprite2d will have their own jitter issues as well whereas a PNG used for the sprite2d texture won't (you can see with the default icon.svg)

Here is the github link to the project files if you want to see. https://github.com/mmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmdonuts/ColorRectVibrationBug 

### Steps to reproduce

Simply run the sample project. The color rects and texturerect that has been scaled down both will have a noticeable vibration as the camera moves (tried both smoothing and unsmoothed movement). However, a texturerect (or sprite2d) without scaling the texture file down won't display the vibration.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

https://github.com/mmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmdonuts/ColorRectVibrationBug
